summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine PDMR share transactions under UK MAR. PDMRs entered into irrevocable trading plans on 3 August 2026 allowing sale of up to 25% of vested shares, with first trades no earlier than 30 days later and expiration by 22 July 2027. Separately, CEO Robert Begbie sold 137,547 shares at £7.2456 on 4 August 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. The filing is a routine notification of insider trading plans and sales, not a special situation. No strategic event, offer, or corporate action is involved.
